detail:
New decision "Chose to restore archived decisions to a remembered archived_from status rather than refusing to archive non-active decisions" relates to:
- 01KX3HRWY6BJP6K7PKH326GB60: "Chose Health as a section in the Insights tab over an 8th tab"
- 01KX3SE6EYBP8GS17ASMY7MCW0: "Plan includes full code for server endpoints and pins module contracts/algorithms (round-robin neighborhood selection, virtualization math, count-mismatch refetch) for frontend components rather than dumping complete UI code into the plan"
- 01KX4AE91FH5X4ZGDXEEXWD75Q: "Accepted implementer's deviation from the plan's http-server.ts wiring snippet: `handled ? true : apiHandler(req,res)` instead of `handled ? undefined : ...`"
- 01KX4ANS5WVTW3X95Z6Q6PNGFV: "Resolved review finding on delta requests re-reading the full store: deliberately deferred"
- 01KX4BG3BH66MF38DFX029MNFR: "Accepted implementer judgment: /api/graph/entities sort is a fixed degree-desc/name-asc default and the sort query param is ignored rather than switchable"
- 01KX4DQE1FXKH46X5B21RS3E6M: "Documented a known blind spot rather than engineering around it: a superseded→archived flip with no other project activity is invisible to /api/status counts, so the store catches it on the next real change via post-merge count validation"
- 01KX4E5JKVC6Y7VBSYXTKS832F: "main.js runs its own 5s /api/status poll for store delta detection rather than intercepting app.js's fetchStatus"
- 01KX4PQMPXF7DTDRFBWRGW0A3Q: "Ledger corrected: Task 16's 'filter param sanitized' claim was inaccurate at the time (only internal keys were stripped on WRITE); the read-side allowlist now actually exists in router.js."
- 01KX4Q6127VC60FYFWS0RH4T79: "Unknown-id resolution probes /api/graph/neighborhood with limit=1 before navigating"
- 01KY2SN8VMJRAHX771QCB4TYFD: "Chose a pre-bind same-project probe across the full port retry window (config.port..+5) for the #42 single-instance guard, reusing the existing /api/health projectRoot check"
- 01KY74RABXEDF7CR3T2RPT8GN0: "Chose lazy-once construction of the triage StoreSet (getTriageStores mirroring getSearchEngines) over eager construction at createApiHandler closure time"
- 01KY752JQP080H6GDKS3SH7S8T: "Chose to route triage row clicks through main.js's existing __twiningNavigateToId bridge over setting location.hash directly in the view"
- 01KY752JY2YY57EN6HZV5BP0XB: "Chose to add the applyRoute triage-refresh line in addition to the tab-button click handler"
- 01KY793ECR4YDRQJF752M13QC4: "Kept the lazy-once triage StoreSet in createApiHandler over the spec §7 letter (eager construction in the closure)"
- 01KY7VWPQWQ69YE6H22KC105AM: "Chose to linkify only http(s) URLs, DOM-constructed with stopPropagation anchors, and explicitly NOT file paths"
- 01KY7WMA8EJ0TTB68YXGPV7546: "Chose an undifferentiated 404 for every raw-route deny reason (traversal, dotted segment, symlink escape, missing) and text/plain+nosniff for ALL content"
- 01KZ6J7B6Z3NS6W5J6737SXS6A: "Chose a MEAN of per-decision quality with de-duplication on normalised summary as the volume defence, rather than any coverage or count term"
- 01KZD9DEE3C8VZVFFKZM8WTT9V: "Chose to tombstone archive_stale's blackboard dismissals and correct the tool text rather than extend twining_unarchive to restore blackboard entries"
